author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Schema Forge
summary: A flesh golem stoking the forge and the animated armor it pressed fight among the molds every entry is cast in.

parts.text: Heat rolls out of a vault lined with iron molds, each stamped with the name of a kind of entry. A huge stitched figure works the bellows, and five suits of armor stand in a row beside the anvil, fresh from the molds and still smoking.

The {ref:creature/flesh-golem} was set to press new entries and never told to stop. It attacks anything that isn't an entry, and orders the {ref:creature/animated-armor} to do the same. Fire makes it hesitate; the forge's coals are close at hand. Every mold here is sound: an entry pressed in one fits the gate upstairs exactly. The party can test a visitor card in the hero mold to prove that the card's shape is right and the fault lies further in.
